# Texas Tech University Departments

> > Central directory and information hub for Texas Tech University's academic departments, administrative units, and specialized programs serving students, faculty, and staff.

This site provides access to departmental resources across TTU, with particular emphasis on the Department of Agricultural and Applied Economics (AAEC), undergraduate admissions processes, and administrative services. It serves as the primary gateway for prospective students, current students, and university personnel to navigate TTU's organizational structure.

## Key Topics

- Texas Tech University (TTU)
- Department of Agricultural and Applied Economics (AAEC)
- College of Agricultural Sciences and Natural Resources (CASNR)
- Undergraduate Admissions
- Transfer Students
- International Admissions
- Residency Determination
- ApplyTexas and Common App
- Agricultural Economics Programs
- ICAC (International Center for Agricultural Competitiveness)
- TAFI (Thornton Agricultural Finance Institute)
- Military and Veteran Students
- Test-Optional Admissions
- RaiderConnect
- Lubbock, Texas

## Undergraduate Admissions

- [Apply to Texas Tech](https://www.depts.ttu.edu/admissions/apply): TTU undergraduate application process for domestic and international students
- [Transfer Student Admissions](https://www.depts.ttu.edu/admissions/apply/status/transfer): Transfer student admission requirements and application process
- [International Admissions](https://www.depts.ttu.edu/admissions/international/apply): International undergraduate admission requirements and I-20 process
- [Military & Veteran Admissions](https://www.depts.ttu.edu/admissions/Military): Purple Heart University admissions for military and veteran students
- [Residency Determination](https://www.depts.ttu.edu/admissions/residency): Texas residency determination for tuition classification purposes
- [Admissions en Español](https://www.depts.ttu.edu/admissions/espanol): Spanish-language admissions information for freshmen and transfers
- [Roadmap to Raiderland](https://www.depts.ttu.edu/admissions/roadmap): College preparation roadmap for prospective Red Raiders

## Agricultural and Applied Economics (AAEC)

- [Master of Agribusiness Program](https://www.depts.ttu.edu/aaec/agribusiness): AAEC Master of Agribusiness program with online and internship options
- [Thornton Agricultural Finance Institute (TAFI)](https://www.depts.ttu.edu/aaec/tafi): Thornton Agricultural Finance Institute research and outreach programs
- [Undergraduate Internships](https://www.depts.ttu.edu/aaec/Undergraduate-internships/index.php): AAEC undergraduate internship opportunities in agricultural economics
- [AAEC Department History](https://www.depts.ttu.edu/aaec/history/index.php): AAEC department history with faculty recollections and oral histories
- [Agricultural Economics Graduate Student Association (AEGSA)](https://www.depts.ttu.edu/aaec/student_orgs/aegsa/index.php): AEGSA graduate student organization for agricultural economics
- [ICAC News and Updates](https://www.depts.ttu.edu/aaec/icac/news/index.php): ICAC news archive on farm policy, trade, and cotton industry

## Department Directory

- [TTU Departments Home](https://www.depts.ttu.edu): Main directory of TTU departments and organizational units

## Support and Resources

- [Admissions Contact Information](https://www.depts.ttu.edu/admissions/staff): Undergraduate Admissions contact info and recruitment center locations
- [International Admissions Staff](https://www.depts.ttu.edu/admissions/international/staff): International admissions staff directory and contact information
- [Accounting Services FAQs](https://www.depts.ttu.edu/accountingservices/faqs.php): Accounting Services FAQs on allowable expenses and fund types
- [ICAC Helpful Links](https://www.depts.ttu.edu/aaec/icac/links/index.php): ICAC agricultural resources and industry organization links

## Optional

- [Director of Undergraduate Admissions](https://www.depts.ttu.edu/admissions/director): Jason Hale, Director of Undergraduate Admissions profile
- [AEGSA Scientific Communication Workshop](https://www.depts.ttu.edu/aaec/featured_news_and_upcoming_Events/events/workshop_AEGSA.php): AEGSA workshop on scientific communication for grad students
